verdict.rationale: Polar's platform source is published at github.com/polarsource/polar under the Apache-2.0 open-source license, with 10k+ stars and the self-description "An open source and transparent Merchant of Record." The docs and the live-probed llms.txt both repeat the "Open Source & Global Merchant of Record" positioning. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of the repository contents and license file, beyond the vendor's own claims.
